svg.text: MySQL 8.4 LTS · one instance, one database per service · scales vertically
P4 · Data stores and platform connections
UML deployment diagram of stores and platform calls · ADR-001, ADR-004, ADR-006, ADR-010 · arrows from user to used · proposed
on the host, not a container
Every Spring service also needs Keycloak's signing keys; that
connection is not drawn and its route is open (P-05). Calls to a
platform component or to the calendar are not service-to-service
Google Calendar does not guarantee that event-ID collisions are
detected at creation (E87), so Dispatch still queries by ID
